caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, sculpted figure of a cow standing atop a large, horizontally oriented arrow. The cow is rendered in shades of brown and green, with visible patina suggesting a metallic surface, possibly copper or bronze. Its body is realistically modeled, with prominent muscles and anatomical features. The arrow beneath the cow is colored in brown and grayish tones, with its pointed tip on the right side and large, fletched feathers on the left, which exhibit hues of blue and green. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The composition is centered, with the cow and arrow as the main focus, occupying most of the space within the drawing.
title: Cow Weather Vane
